title: Evaluation on sign inputs
statement: For a decision tree on $n$ coordinates, define its Boolean-cube function on inputs $x\in\{ -1,1\}^n$ by converting each sign coordinate to its corresponding element of $\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z$ and evaluating the tree there. The function returns a sign.
